{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

# Display number of patients with multiple rows and the number of such patients
num_duplicate_patients = len(duplicates)
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {num_duplicate_patients}")
print(f"Total number of rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Total number of unique patient_id values: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")"}
